items.summary: Nothing is more pleasing than beautiful code. And nothing is more heart-breaking than watching beautiful code get destroyed. items.title: Terra Firma
items.summary: This is my entry into the BlitzCoder Stupidest Game Competition, 2002. You need to guide a sky diver—whose parachute has failed—past obstacles and attempt to land on a cow. Fun! It was written using BlitzBasic and later recompiled in BlitzPlus. This is the game that made me realise I could make games. Archived web page: gingerbeardman.com/archive/terrafirma…

items.title: Simple Soccer
items.summary: Simple Soccer is my take on the classic Sensible Soccer. It was written in BlitzBasic and ran at 800×600 under Windows 9x. I built multiple parts—player control, dribbling, cpu and formation, goalkeeper behaviour—but never managed to combine it all in a finished game. Still, I count it as my first real game.
